newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 6.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast Privatisation Committee to decide on Thursday who takes over as operator of state telephone company CI-TELCOM after examining bids from France-Telecom, Telekom Malaysia and largely Ivorian consortium, Africa Bell.
- Education Minister Saliou Toure appeals for calm at Ivorian universities after reported acts of vandalism by students protesting over non-payment of grants.
- U.S. trade mission comprising 42 investors and business leaders to visit Ivory Coast from Januray 12 to 16, says advertisement by Centre for Promotion of Investment in Ivory Coast.
- Four arrested student leaders to be brought to court on Tuesday on charges of inciting violence.
- U.S. telecoms giant AT&T takes 35 percent stake in Africa Bell, an Ivorian-led consortium vying with France Telecom and Telekom Malaysia for takeover of Ivory Coast phone company, CI-TELCOM.
